title: Plasma Exchange and Continuous Hemodiafiltration in Treatment of Wilson's Disease-related Liver Failure
brief_summary: This study is to investigate the clinical efficacy of artificial liver support system using combination of plasma exchange and continuous hemodiafiltration in treatment of Wilson's Disease - related liver failure. 30 patients will receive treatment of plasma exchange and continuous hemodiafiltration and internal medicine. 30 patients will receive treatment of internal medicine.
